integrity: Theorem established symbolically from quadratic character sums and projective conic geometry; standalone finite-field checks are supplementary. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not count degenerate or non-pointwise-rational hexagons.
Does not resolve scheme-theoretic fiber multiplicities or sixty-line coincidence strata.
Possible unindexed older finite-geometry priority remains.
scientific_scope: All smooth plane conics over finite fields of order \(q=3^m\) with \(m\ge2\); every rational line; dihedrally unlabelled cyclic arrangements of six pairwise distinct rational conic points, counted with multiplicities.
title: Exact characteristic-three Pascal-line fibers of rational conic hexagons
